text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C after sizable gains—and Stock A after a small gain—felt rewarding, but I should not let my average cost alone decide when to sell.","I waited through substantial losses in Stocks D and E before selling; avoiding the pain of realizing a loss can allow a position to deteriorate further.","My account value fell while I mostly made no trades, so I should review the whole portfolio regularly and make decisions based on current circumstances, not simply hold or rely on past price moves."]}
